name: Select layers and objects – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: While pressing ⇧ Shift , click matching objects to add them to the selection. You won't need to double-click objects nested deep inside other groups or frames.

name: Select layers in a slide deck – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: Double-click on the layer, or press Enter , to select one level of nesting down. Repeat this process until you select the correct child elements. Deep select

name: Select, move, and order objects in FigJam – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: Group Groups allow you to combine objects together so they can be treated like a single object. To select a group, click on one of the grouped objects.

name: Arrange layers with Smart selection – Figma Learn - Help Center
snippet: To mark all layers on the same axis in a 2D selection, hold Shift and double-click on any layer. Double-click again to select all layers in the selection.
